item.description: Las tablillas y papiros de la antigüedad son cápsulas del tiempo que nos muestran un momento concreto del pasado de forma fascinante, a veces incluso en primera persona. Hay de todo, desde el sistema trigonométrico más antiguo del mundo , o de geometría aplicada mil años antes de Pitágoras , hasta historias o anécdotas que nos desvelan cómo era la vida hace miles de años . item.description: Fierce competition in some areas of London means landlord purchasers are making successful lowball offers The average price of a home coming up for sale in Britain’s richest borough has dropped by almost £100,000 in a month as fierce competition among sellers in many areas prompts some to slash their price expectations, data shows. The property website Rightmove said that for Britain as a whole, average newly listed asking prices for homes had fallen by 2% over the past month, the largest August price drop in eight years.
